extracted.intended_audience: researchers, journalists, prospective grantees, and members of the public looking up Mellon Foundation grant awards
extracted.subtask_description: A public listing of Mellon Foundation grants showing basic award metadata (grantee name, description of purpose, location, and year awarded) for searching and inspection of past awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantee
rubrics_metrics.description: The name of the organization or individual receiving the grant (displayed as 'Grantee').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify the recipient organization or individual for each award entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant description
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief statement of the purpose or intended use of the grant (displayed as 'Grant description').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes why the grant was made (e.g., 'To support general operations', 'To continue support for the Citizenship Project').

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic location associated with the grantee or the funded activity (displayed as 'Location').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typically a U.S. state or territory (e.g., 'New York', 'Puerto Rico') and used for filtering or regional analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year awarded
rubrics_metrics.description: The year in which the grant was awarded (displayed as 'Year awarded').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides temporal context for the award (e.g., '2024') and supports chronological sorting or trend analysis.
